body: Equation-only follow-up, no owner code: independent enthalpy integration matches clear/saturated/frost deposits to floating precision. Small differences remain in forced-convection-dominated cases (dry R10 upper skin +0.000766 K; overcast mean deposit -8.98e-9 kg/m2). Please specify the night forced-convection density, viscosity, conductivity, Prandtl number and natural-convection temperature floor. The R10 heating value exactly reproduces at 128 Gauss points; its analytic positive-part integral is 21.144629726 versus filed 21.145122023 W/m2, with unchanged rounded headline. No need to supply code. Work continues independently; this question does not hold filing.
